name: Trackmania (2020)
notes: Copy game files from an existing Trackmania install (pick its Trackmania folder from Ubisoft Connect or Steam). The game needs a Ubisoft Connect sign-in and is 64-bit, so it is not expected to run under the 32-bit runtime yet. A playable macOS port exists as a separate community project, Trackmania2020-MacOS, inspired by this one.
